summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc reporting that non-executive director and Chairman July Ndlovu purchased 15,000 common shares at $24.81 per share on May 13, 2026. The filing is a routine director shareholding notification under UK Market Abuse Regulation, disclosed via press release and submitted to the SEC as a foreign private issuer report. It does not constitute a special-situations event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or management change. The filing merely records an insider transaction with no structural change, recommendation, or strategic implications.
